module Shop where

import DA.Assert
import Asset

type ShopId = ContractId Shop
type OfferId = ContractId Offer
type VendorInviteId = ContractId VendorInvite
type VendorRelationshipId = ContractId VendorRelationship
type UserInviteId = ContractId UserInvite
type UserRelationshipId = ContractId UserRelationship

template Shop
  with
    owner : Party
    vendors : [Party]
    users : [Party]
    offerIds : [OfferId]
  where
    signatory owner
    observer users, vendors
    controller owner can
      InviteVendor : (ShopId, VendorInviteId)
        with vendor : Party
        do
          shopId <- create this with vendors = vendor :: vendors
          invite <- create VendorInvite with ..
          pure (shopId, invite)
      InviteUser : (ShopId, UserInviteId)
        with user : Party
        do
          shopId <- create this with users = user :: users
          inviteId <- create UserInvite with ..
          pure (shopId, inviteId)

template VendorInvite
  with
    owner : Party
    vendor : Party
  where
    signatory owner
    controller vendor can
      AcceptVendorInvite : VendorRelationshipId
        do create VendorRelationship with ..

template VendorRelationship
  with
    owner : Party
    vendor : Party
  where
    signatory owner, vendor
    controller vendor can
      nonconsuming OfferItem : (ShopId, OfferId)
        with
          shopId : ShopId
          itemId : ItemId
          price : Decimal
          currency : Text
        do
          shop <- fetch shopId
          disclosedItemId <- exercise itemId Disclose with users = owner :: shop.users
          offerId <- create Offer with itemId = disclosedItemId; users = shop.users; ..
          shopId <- create shop with offerIds = offerId :: shop.offerIds
          pure (shopId, offerId)
          
template UserInvite
  with
    owner : Party
    user : Party
  where
    signatory owner
    controller user can
      AcceptUserInvite : UserRelationshipId
        do create UserRelationship with ..

template UserRelationship
  with
    owner : Party
    user : Party
  where
    signatory owner, user
    controller user can
      nonconsuming BuyItem : (ShopId, ItemId, IouId)
        with
          shopId : ShopId
          offerId : OfferId
          iouId : IouId
        do
          shop <- fetch shopId
          offer <- fetch offerId
          iou <- fetch iouId
          offer.price === iou.amount
          offer.currency === iou.currency
          assert $ any (== offerId) shop.offerIds

          newShopId <- create shop with offerIds = filter (/= offerId) shop.offerIds
          newItemId <- exercise offerId Settle with buyer = user
          newIouId <- exercise iouId TransferIou with newOwner = offer.vendor
          pure (newShopId, newItemId, newIouId)

  transferredIou <- submit issuer do exerciseCmd iouId TransferIou with newOwner = user

  parties@Actors{..} <- actors

  (vendorShop, vendorRelationship) <- addVendor parties initialShop
  (readyShop, userRelationship) <- addUser parties vendorShop

  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd vendorRelationship OfferItem with
    shopId = readyShop; itemId; price = 12.0; currency = "USD"
  (offeredShop, offerId) <- submit vendor do exerciseCmd vendorRelationship OfferItem with
    shopId = readyShop; itemId; price = 12.0; currency = "USD"

  assert (offer.currency == "USD" && offer.users == [user])
  Some disclosedItem <- queryContractId producer offer.itemId

  assert (paidIou.owner == vendor && paidIou.issuer == issuer)

testMultipleOffers : Script ()
testMultipleOffers = do
  parties@Actors{..} <- actors
  initialShop <- openShop parties
  (vendorShop, vendorRelationship) <- addVendor parties initialShop
  (readyShop, userRelationship) <- addUser parties vendorShop
  firstItem <- newItem parties
  (oneOfferShop, firstOffer) <- submit vendor do exerciseCmd vendorRelationship OfferItem with shopId = readyShop; itemId = firstItem; price = 12.0; currency = \"USD\"

  (twoOfferShop, secondOffer) <- submit vendor do exerciseCmd vendorRelationship OfferItem with shopId = oneOfferShop; itemId = secondItem; price = 20.0; currency = \"EUR\"
  Some twoOffers <- queryContractId owner twoOfferShop
  assert (twoOffers.offerIds == [secondOffer, firstOffer])
  firstPayment <- newIou parties 12.0 \"USD\"
  (oneRemainingShop, firstPurchased, firstPaid) <- submit user do exerciseCmd userRelationship BuyItem with shopId = twoOfferShop; offerId = firstOffer; iouId = firstPayment
  Some oneRemaining <- queryContractId owner oneRemainingShop
  assert (oneRemaining.offerIds == [secondOffer])
  Some firstPurchasedItem <- queryContractId producer firstPurchased
  Some firstPaidIou <- queryContractId issuer firstPaid
  assert (firstPurchasedItem.owner == user && firstPaidIou.owner == vendor)
  secondPayment <- newIou parties 20.0 \"EUR\"
  (emptyShop, secondPurchased, secondPaid) <- submit user do exerciseCmd userRelationship BuyItem with shopId = oneRemainingShop; offerId = secondOffer; iouId = secondPayment
  Some empty <- queryContractId owner emptyShop
  assert (empty.offerIds == [] && empty.vendors == [vendor] && empty.users == [user])
  Some secondPurchasedItem <- queryContractId producer secondPurchased
  Some secondPaidIou <- queryContractId issuer secondPaid
  assert (secondPurchasedItem.owner == user && secondPaidIou.owner == vendor)
  assert (secondPaidIou.amount == 20.0 && secondPaidIou.currency == \"EUR\")

testInvalidOffers : Script ()

  initialShop <- openShop parties

  otherItem <- submit producer do createCmd Item with producer; owner = producer; label = \"Not for sale\"; quantity = 1.0; unit = \"each\"; observers = [vendor]
